title: Single-cell RNA-sequencing of metastatic pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor
description: We report the application of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) technology for single-cell level profiling of the transcriptional features of cells from two primary lesions, one liver metastasis, one normal liver tissue, and peripheral blood monocuclear cells in a patient with metastatic pNET. The transcriptomic profiles of a total of 24.544 cells were captured. Overall design: Single-cell RNA-sequencing of two primery tumors, one metastatic tumor, one normal liver tissue, and peripheral blood mononuclear cells from one pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor patient with liver metastasis
